import narwhals as nw

# Scan the parquet file lazily with polars backend
df = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Build the lazy pipeline: filter and select columns
lazy_df = (
    df
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
)

# Materialize the pipeline into a concrete in-memory dataframe
result = lazy_df.collect()

print(result)
